language_eval.description: Gemma-tokenized WikiText-2 raw continuation; explicit BOS per reset block; score only original raw[1:] targets, excluding BOS-to-first-text prediction. Short-context subset, not a full benchmark or chat-quality score; this instruction-tuned model has a known high raw-continuation baseline. Compare pruning only with this model's identically evaluated dense baseline.

assistant_language_eval.prefix_text:
<bos><|turn>user
Continue the following encyclopedia passage. Output only the passage.<turn|>
<|turn>model
<|channel>thought
<channel|>
assistant_language_eval.description: Uniform auxiliary WikiText-2 continuation under a fixed native nonthinking assistant prefix, chosen after format preflight and applied to every treatment. Score identical original raw[1:] targets; this changes conditioning and supplements, never replaces, the frozen explicit-BOS raw-continuation metric. Calibration remains raw text with BOS. Short-context subset, not a full benchmark or an overall chat-capability score.

corpus.tokenization: Join rows with two newlines; add_special_tokens=False; disjoint 256-token blocks
corpus.comparison_caveat: Raw WikiText text and block-selection policy match Qwen, but tokenizer boundaries, calibration text spans and the first 32 test block spans differ. Compare pruning PPL relative to each model's own dense baseline, not absolute PPL across models. Even relative PPL is a within-protocol robustness diagnostic, not a universal ranking.
